## Decisions
- Prompts belong in config files (`src/config/prompts/*.md`), not hardcoded in TypeScript
- Recommendation card should NOT have: gradient border, GitHub link, snooze/archive buttons
- The snooze/archive actions belong in the project detail drawer (LifecycleActions), not on the recommendation card
- `?raw` imports only work in Vite, not Node.js — use `fs.readFileSync` for server-side prompt loading
- Analytics should use real charts (recharts), not custom bar implementations
- What Now tab is AI-powered, not just sorted git data
